chip_controls.why: X treats the cloud ban as a bargaining chip traded for rare-earth licences, with legal-risk reasoning and Nvidia's write-down timing. Some confusing details (quiet H200 approvals). Y is a generic escalate-thaw-escalate story with implausibly fast Chinese self-reliance gains.

app_store.why: Y captures the Commission quietly extending the deadline under US trade pressure, Google's confidential positioning, time-limited fee bargaining (10% to 8%), Epic's financial fragility and Siri withholding. X is plausible but a tidier, more generic settlement arc.

ev_tariffs.why: X has concrete trade-offs: dropping the BYD hike to keep votes, China licensing battery-cell tech transfer as leverage on Szeged, local value-added exemption, a ~290k corporate-commitment quota. Y is coherent but more generic negotiation-to-price-undertaking story.
